newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan buys 4,500 tonnes RBD palm oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 4,500 tonnes RBD palm oil.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil on Thursday at $529.40 per tonne C & F from Pan Century for shipment by December 10.
They said the TCP had scrapped its tender for 2,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein, feeling that quoted prices were too high.
The prices quoted for palm oil were in the range of $529.37 to $535 per tonne. The two bids for the palm olein deal were $571 per tonne and $568.70 per tonne, one dealer said.
The TCP called the tender on behalf of the state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan on Wednesday.
The dealer said Pakistan was likely to enter the market again in the next two weeks.
